# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the latest published release is supported. Please update before reporting an issue.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Do not open a public GitHub issue for security vulnerabilities (credential handling, cookie storage, update/executable-replacement flow, etc).

Instead, report it privately via a [GitHub Security Advisory](https://github.com/jonuffykk/jSpoofer/security/advisories/new) or by contacting the maintainer directly through the links in the [README](../README.md).

Include: affected version, reproduction steps, and impact. Expect an initial response within a few days.
